verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a cardholder disputes capability for submitting and managing debit card disputes in line with Reg E and card network requirements. ACH-side support is evidenced only as return handling: returning originated ACH transfers and status/return-code updates, not consumer ACH dispute investigations. Missing for 10: documented Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, explicit ops-user responsibilities, ACH unauthorized-debit dispute workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
